Matched-pair representation (Rosenbaum 2012)

Source: R/pair-reps.R
riposte_pair_rep.Rd

A representation for riposte_test() and riposte_components() that scores each pair by the rank of its absolute difference among all pairs, and gives that score to the unit with the larger outcome. Every block must be a pair (two units, one treated). See riposte_pairs_scores() for the scores.

Usage

riposte_pair_rep(
  type = c("wilcoxon", "brown", "noether", "ustat"),
  m = 8,
  m1 = 7,
  m2 = 8,
  exact = TRUE
)

Arguments

type

"wilcoxon" (ranks of |y|), "brown" (Brown / Markowski- Hettmansperger combined quantile average, quantiles 1/3 and 2/3), "noether" (0/1 for ranks in the top third), or "ustat" (Rosenbaum's 2011 U-statistic, needs m, m1, m2).

m, m1, m2

U-statistic indices with 1 <= m1 <= m2 <= m; (8, 7, 8) and (8, 6, 7) are the two highlighted in Rosenbaum (2012).

exact

for "ustat", use the integer form sum choose(a-1, l-1) * choose(I-a, m-l) of the paper (TRUE) or the smooth approximation (FALSE, what testtwice::multrnk() does by default).

Value

a function of (y, block) of class "riposte_pooled_rep", carrying the pair-level score function as attribute pair_scores.
